entries.embedded_english: You got him!  Damn, that was beautiful!
Bagged yourself your first Tiger, soldier.  Nice work.
Some tough terrain.  Nothing this baby can't handle, though!
Got it.  Now find the other one and ace it the same way.
Ah-! TIGER!
He's hit!  Pull back!
Command tank's destroyed.  Hell - the Krauts have got a damn Tiger tank dug into  that building over there!
That's it, then.  We try crossing that bridge to get within range of even scratching it from a frontal attack, and we're gonna get picked off like crows sitting on a telephone wire!
It's gone.  Road's clear ahead.  Let's get rolling.
Flak 88’s…Anti-Tank guns, hidden in the tree line.  Move forward and protect our Infantry from any Jerry soldiers as they take out those damn guns!!’
Infantry incoming!
Okay, halt, and batten down the hatches.  Air Force are coming in now.
Lotta Kraut positions in those fields.  They're dug in real good, too.
Then we'll just have to dig 'em back out again.  Nothing this baby can't handle, remember?
Got it!  Fine shooting there, pal.
North West
Hell!  More of 'em in the treeline ahead!
FIRE!
They got two of our guys!
It's not enough! We're surrounded!, get us out of here!
On our right!  Traverse turret and fire!
Enemy tanks on the far riverbank.  You got any spare rounds left, you know where to put 'em.
Blast that enemy armor, soldier.  If we don't knock them out now, we'll be meeting them much closer up when we get across that river.
Take it easy. Watch those woods for ambush points.
Thanks for that boys!, We've got it.. Move out!
‘Finish off any remaining Jerries, men!’
Hose 'em with the MG.  That's what it's there for.
We'll take it down the other side of the ridge and meet up with the rest of our guys.  Watch out for any stray Krauts.
Here they come!  Ha, look at that!  Krauts don't know what hit 'em!
Thanks boys, we’ll finish off the rest, 4th and 80th move out at full speed’.
Grasons Tank just bought it!
Targets inbound!
What the hell was that?!
<on radio>  Incoming from those woods.  All units, pull back!
Incoming! Over to the South East!
That's it.  Last one taken care of.  Nice firing, son.
Keep it up with those shells, soldier.
Another one down!
Still some German guns in action up top of that ridge.  We're breaking off to engage.
Another one!   They're on our flanks!
Okay, we're across.  Let's find that hidden tank and get that bridge secured.
Easy does it...
Oh man. Oh man oh man oh man oh man oh man...
We for German infantry.  Give it to 'em, cowboy.
That’s how you do it in my town boys...ha ha!!  Move on out
Road's clear.   Let's move on out to Bastogne.  Gonna be a Merry Christmas after all, for our boys there...
What the??…Jones’ just bought it!!
Keep in formation and keep moving.
Visibility's lousy, with all this snow.

Yeah, and who knows how many krauts we got hiding in those woods.  Gotta push on, though.  If we don't get to Bastogne and relieve our guys there, there's no saying who much more damage this German counter-offensive could do.
‘Damn Jerries, people here didn’t stand a chance’
‘That’s why we’re here, soldier, to kick Jerry where it hurts’.
<on radio>  German Panzers on our right and left flanks.  Units on those flanks - peel off and engage.
That's us.  Move right and engage.  Damn Krauts are trying to catch us in a pincer movement.
Watch yourselves, they have Panzershreks!!
Got another one!
Taking us back round to rejoin formation.
Man, they're dug in deep.
Here come those tanks.  Told you we shoulda blasted them when we had the chance!
Keep your eyes open.  You just know that Tiger's going to have units in place to cover its ass end...
<on radio>  Bridge ahead.  We'll have to cross single file only.  Command is taking point.  Cover me.
Oh Man, I got a bad feeling about this one...
That's it.  The 80th can clear the treeline now, and.....Hell!
Panzer!  Panzer coming out of those woods!
They got one of our guys!
Our lead Shermans are taking fire from German guns up on that ridge.  Aren't we goign to return fire?
We keep going.  Someone else is going to take care of that.
<on radio>  All tanks.  Prepare to stop on my command.  We've got air support coming in to clear that ridge.
More of them to the North!
There, dead ahead!  Fire!
We got Kraut infantry advancing out of that treeline.
There they are.  Fire!
